scope: Birth-pinned journal and staged no-permission admission recovery, selected native and real CPU lifecycle/proof tests. No new production ABI or proof format.

implementation.birth_pin: DurableDag creation pins the real journal dev/inode before leases; zero store denotes only an unassigned namespace. Recovery pins historical journals on rebase.
implementation.ordering: Durable Unissued -> launch-store worker/reservation markers -> Preparing(path) -> durable supervisor journal -> Authorized(path,directory) -> task/permit publication -> dispatch.
implementation.direct: Direct issuance reserves before binding its direct role. Direct/uncertain historical attempts cannot use preparation reconciliation.
implementation.snapshots: LVDAG003 requires a pinned root and distinguishes Unissued, Preparing and Authorized. A zero/unassigned store is allowed only for no bindings or Unissued bindings. V1/V2 readers preserved; V2 rejects an unassigned store.
implementation.reconciliation: PreparationReceipt is a durable no-permission reconciliation result, not an OS stop receipt. It rejects active verification, Direct, historical Supervised, Authorized and unknown phases; holds revocation/idle gates through recovery rebase.
implementation.capacity: Unissued without a launch record consumes no new registry slot, including at full capacity. Existing partial reservations are revoked and gated; tombstones retained.
implementation.failure: Partial reservation errors poison both LaunchStore and DurableDag until recovery.
implementation.worker_guard: CpuWorker::execute requires a WorkerGate whose token binds the canonical assignment, before input verification/proving.
implementation.preservation: Existing LVCPU001/LVCPU002 launch tokens, proof formats, default verifier and production ABI unchanged.
implementation.trust_boundary: Trusted local metadata and exclusive runtime service namespace. Not authentication against hostile same-UID software; no operator journal migration protocol.

checks: eleven explicit pinned CPU checks including copied-Unissued DAG rejection and actual public recovery with receipt retention through rebase
injected error and abrupt exit at four reservation boundaries
abrupt subprocess exit after supervisor journal creation before authorization, and after authorization before task publication
empty/new journals, staged metadata validation before proof callbacks, historical codecs, full-capacity no-new-slot reconciliation and active-verifier/uncertain-role rejection
worker build; narrow/default/all-feature/all-target checks; formatting, whitespace and archived-source comparison

prior_attempts.warning_scope: non-stream block-v2 check; unused check_launch methods
prior_attempts.result: All tests passed; two non-stream unused-helper warnings corrected by feature gating in c.

security.fixed_parameters: Cubic Goldilocks X^3-X-1; q128; blowup16; cap6; four random codewords; PoW16; one AIR; fresh CSPRNG and strict CPU single-zero-terminal verification.
security.aggregation: Public-proof-only; no aggregator wallet witnesses, individual proofs in blocks, curve/SNARK wraps, weakened parameters or multiple roots.
security.backend: Zig frontend with approved Plonky3 backend exception.

remaining: Same-boot unseen/delayed dispatch liveness without unsafe stop inference.
Concurrent CPU-verifier drain/recovery; OOM/timeout and repeated lifecycle qualification.
Physical scratch enforcement and reference-aware launch/task/artifact retention.
Actual SingleWallet/Empty/Merge operation generation, arrival-driven host eligibility/reorgs, issuance and HTLC.

Profile immutable preprocessing reuse: CpuWorker creates a local ConstructionSession and clears it for every job. Cached work must remain public, identity-bound and resource-accounted, with fresh proof randomness.
GPU redundant-transfer reduction followed by at least five alternating matched comparisons; unchanged pilot not promoted.
Full64 cold<=600s and complete post-seal<=180s at12-minute cadence, one root<=2MiB and aggregate RAM48/VRAM12/scratch128GiB.
Full-tree soundness/ZK review, host integration and explicit activation.

stages.verified: Captured live worker, durable revocation, exact kernel/cgroup stop, no proof result.
Fresh actor reconciles exact old worker before epoch2 rebase, releases resources and does not revive historical candidate eligibility.
Actual full-strength WrapPair independently CPU-verified, durably accepted and exported.
Fresh CPU replay accepts proof and rejects wrong order and mutation.
